title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 174
paragraphs: There were also the Pedasians, who lived in the interior above Halicarnassos. Among them, whenever disaster was about to strike either themselves or their neighbors, the priestess of Athena would grow a great beard. This happened to them three times. They were the only people in all of Caria who held out against Harpagos for any length of time. They caused him considerable trouble by fortifying a hill called Lide.
